items.title: Sonny Henry Interview, 1959-01-08
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...And Willie, Willie Jackson. Willie Jackson. Nookie Johnson, Willie Jackson. [INTERVIEWEE] Those are two singers.

ctx.x: Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah.
Was that being Nookie Johnson? Did you know him? Johnson. And Willie, Willie Jackson. Willie Jackson. Nookie Johnson, Willie Jackson.

Those are two singers. This old man. That old man used to play bass. I can't think of his name. Just died recently? Oh no, he'd been dead. He was a bass player. Well, him and Johnson and this other fella he was talking about, there's three of them used play together one played a mandle one played a guitar the other played the bass but there was the one composed that song about maestress waggon and vignon taking my function gone i don't know that how does that go see yeah there was a song there they had a…
